source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Obtain liver enzymes every month for all patients taking atorvastatin regardless of symptoms, risk factors, or previous results.","B":"Avoid all liver-enzyme testing after atorvastatin is started because transaminase results do not contribute to medication-safety assessment.","C":"Wait to obtain any baseline liver assessment until symptoms of hepatic injury develop after atorvastatin therapy has already begun.","D":"Consider liver-enzyme testing before atorvastatin is started and repeat it when clinically indicated rather than following a fixed monthly schedule."}}
source_row.rationale: Atorvastatin labeling advises considering liver-enzyme testing before initiation and as clinically indicated thereafter.
